initial_human_action: one explicit AppKey Keychain save followed by one PKCE authorization in the loopback Operator UI
persisted_values: SIM AppKey public client identifier in a separate user-confirmed Keychain entry
opaque HMAC account binding key and fingerprint

app_key_configuration.input: loopback Operator UI password field shown only while unset
app_key_configuration.write_trigger: explicit same-origin CSRF-protected browser click only

refresh_concurrency: single repository-owned file lock then reread latest Keychain credential
refresh_keeper: Operator UI maintains only the OAuth token chain before provider and gate decisions; it never constructs a Saxo OpenAPI client
environment_binding: SIM authorization, token and OpenAPI endpoints only
account_binding: first accepted GET preflight stores only an HMAC fingerprint; later mismatch fails closed
read_only_enforcement: Saxo SIM application must have trading disabled at registration
C2 client exposes allow-listed GET methods only
write request counter must remain zero
kill_switch_effect: block token refresh and every new or active C2 session operation without deleting evidence

gate_separation.oauth_and_refresh_readiness: allowed before provider and operational-gate decisions
gate_separation.sim_observation_start: allowed after AUTH_READY, explicit SIM trading-disabled acknowledgement and kill-switch check; provider, SLA, fee and receipt decisions are non-blocking
gate_separation.sim_allocation_and_paper_evaluation: blocked until the required provider, valuation, fee, accounting, SLA and accepted-receipt gates are complete
gate_separation.live_order_eligibility: prohibited; this credential adapter grants no order or account-mutation capability

refresh_failure: BLOCKED_INTERFACE_OPERATIONAL and no fallback token source
remote_revocation: remove application access in SaxoTraderGO; local disconnect deletes only the Keychain entries
backward_compatibility: the existing in-memory EphemeralSIMReadSession remains the execution core; direct token paste is deprecated and disabled in Operator UI
